svg.aria-label: Popov plot for G(s) = 1/(s squared + s + 1): the curve (Re G(jw), w Im G(jw)). Any straight line through −1/k with slope 1/eta that leaves the whole Popov plot on its right proves absolute stability for the sector [0, k]. Here every line of slope up to 1 through the origin side works, so k can be as large as we like; the circle criterion (vertical line, eta = 0) only allows k < 3
